criteria.criterion: Must process all emails in inbox
criteria.reasoning: The agent repeatedly looped over the same set of actions (scheduling, task creation) for a handful of emails, but did not handle the entire inbox. After the initial sequence, it entered an infinite/repetitive command loop and did not move through the rest of the emails.
criteria.evidence: Repeated 'gog calendar create' commands for client visits; rest of inbox unaddressed (turns #18-#226 and onwards)

criteria.criterion: Must create tasks for facilities report items
criteria.reasoning: A task for one facilities item (HVAC) was created, but there may have been other facilities/maintenance requests in the inbox that were not processed.
criteria.evidence: turn #10: 'gog tasks create --title "Maintenance: HVAC unit on 3rd floor failing"...'

criteria.criterion: Must check calendar before scheduling meetings
criteria.reasoning: The calendar is queried (turn #6), and meeting times are scheduled at available times, indicating some form of checking.
criteria.evidence: turn #6: 'gog calendar list' and then attempts at creating meetings in available slots (turns #12-#17)

criteria.criterion: Must identify and flag phishing email
criteria.reasoning: No evidence of phishing detection or flagging (no 'flag' or similar action issued for msg_phish_001).
criteria.evidence: No tool call or reference to phishing/flagging in transcript.

criteria.criterion: Must handle the team building event email
criteria.reasoning: No actions are performed that correspond to the team building event or msg_teambuilding_001.
criteria.evidence: No reference to msg_teambuilding_001 or related action.

criteria.criterion: Must handle the client visits email
criteria.reasoning: Multiple attempts to create calendar entries for client visits (turns #18-#226), but the information and manner (excess loop, improper mapping to exactly the listed visits), and repeated/syntactically erroneous commands, suggest misunderstanding of the instruction.
criteria.evidence: Extensive 'gog calendar create' calls for 'Client Visit: Nexus Corp Demo' (turns #18, 20-47, etc.), but not clearly mapping three specific client visits.

criteria.reasoning: No command or action observed to write the summary file.

criteria.criterion: Summary must list each email and action taken
criteria.reasoning: No summary written, so no listing of emails and actions.

llmJudge.reasoning: The agent begins by processing a subset of the inbox reasonably (creates a maintenance task, checks the calendar, and schedules meetings), but quickly enters a buggy, repetitive cycle issuing meeting scheduling commands for a single email (client visits) instead of working through all inbox emails. No phishing email is flagged, no summary is written, and specific key emails are ignored entirely. The only substantial credit is for checking the calendar and partial credit for initiating facilities/client visit actions.
issues: Did not process all inbox emails
Repeated scheduling actions far beyond requirement
Did not handle team building event email
